purpose: Baseline inventory of vendored (bundled/inlined) braces@3.0.3 code inside third-party dev-toolchain packages. The graph-level elimination (PR #317) removed braces from the pnpm-resolvable graph; these inlined copies are invisible to pnpm overrides and pnpm audit by construction and are documented as an upstream limitation. Guarded by scripts/check-vendored-braces.mjs on every guards run; the full route analysis and upstream evidence live in docs/quality/vendored-braces-inventory.md.

documented_limitation: The four remaining copies have no safe removal route today (routes A-E re-exhausted with live tarball evidence on 2026-10-07): the latest stable releases of all three tools on every stable line still inline the braces@3.0.3 code (vite 7.3.7 and 8.3.3; rollup 4.64.0; prettier 3.9.9); the code is build-time-inlined into published dist files so dependency upgrades and pnpm overrides cannot alter the bundled bytes; none of the tools officially supports custom rebuilds; and hand-editing generated third-party bundles is forbidden. See docs/quality/vendored-braces-inventory.md for the full route analysis, the adopted tsx-removal route, and the revisit triggers.
